reason: Current full-course pavement independently digitized from pinned licensed satellite imagery. The prior OSM way191172211v4 follows a fence around the venue; the older road chain does not match the current alignment. Source controls include a local-appearance proposal and explicit native-image corrections. Source geometry, direction and georeferencing remain draft estimates; no diagram coordinates or nominal dimensions are traced or fitted. The imagery is not redistributed. The trace retains its source-specific licence instead of being declared OSM-derived. No timing coordinate is available.

preservation: Old fence trace, recipe, track and manifest retained in this one review file. Other track/layout data and all timing/terrain remain exact. No timing or geometry is borrowed from privately sourced material. Raw satellite image is held only in the ignored authoring cache.
limitations: Trace and boundaries are estimates, not a road survey. Image acquisition date/georeferencing error unknown; curbs and banking not established.

borders.screening: Three native-image panels and eight width-extrema sections visually screened. Junctions, paved aprons, white paint and gantry shadows remain uncertain; this is not a surveyed or formally reviewed road limit.

video.review: Car remains visible and on the road across both contact sheets. Camera motion metrics retained with model audit. Full recording decoded without errors.

reproduction.note: Complete GeoJSON reconstructs byte for byte from the registered licensed pixel recipe, pinned cached imagery and retained terrain. No original authoring controls, proposals, smoothing script, meshes or private comparison data are required.
